The modifications in the `mt6359.c` file are aimed at fixing the issue with the regulator lookup for the `vaud18` supply. The original code referenced the regulator supply as `"LDO_VAUD18"`, which was causing failures in the `regulator_dev_lookup()` function due to the absence of the `dev->of_node`. By changing the reference to `"vaud18"`, which corresponds to the regulator name defined in the device tree source (DTS), the code now correctly retrieves the regulator device. This change ensures that the power management for the `vaud18` regulator operates as intended, thereby addressing the power leakage issue noted in the previous commit.
